summary: If you believe #OER should be for all and think accessibility is central to #OER you should renew your commitment to HTML resources. We need to stop cutting off the web from our friends who use screen readers. Get a website, build #OER #a11y

body_html:
If you believe #OER should be for all and think accessibility is central to #OER you should renew your commitment to HTML resources.

We need to stop cutting off the web from our friends who use screen readers.

Get a website, build #OER #a11y
